- [LGRA.13.3] Const declaration: the RHS must **fold to a compile-time
  constant** (the exact, runtime-free foldable subset,
  [LEXP.8.8]); an optional `: type` annotation
  (a scalar builtin type, or a canonical unit) is **checked against
  the folded value** — a mismatch is a compile error; it may reference
  **earlier and imported consts only**; **no runtime construct** (`now()` /
  `cached()`, series aggregations, bindings, runtime-`Json` leaf
  reads, regex — a compile error naming the construct); **no forward or cyclic
  reference**
